visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Counter Factory Instead of Global Variables
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each counter is a global variable with its own copy of the increment function. Write a makeCounter function that returns a new counter with private state. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A closure gives every counter its own private state, so adding a third counter needs no new variable or function, and no other code can change the count by accident.
